title: OneCoin Webniar - 12.05.2016, English
description: OneCoin Webinar hosted by Paul Smith - 12.05.2016.

asr.full_text: Hello from myself Paul Smith and welcome to this week's State of the Nation broadcast for Thursday the 12th of May. As we build into May we celebrate an incredible event in Macau with our CEO and founder Dr Ruzsa using the event to announce a series of exciting initiatives. Let's start talking about them. Onecoin has taken another major step forward in becoming the top cryptocurrency worldwide we are proud to announce that very soon we'll start issuing one net upi cards in association with union pay this gives our members the unique opportunity to receive the cards through a simplified application procedure, without having to go through the full 1PAY KYC. This amazing new service was officially announced by the OneCoin founder and visionary Dr. Ruja Ignatova at the Macau International Convention. The first printed cards are already available in our Hong Kong office, the debit cards, reloadable on a daily basis, are accepted in China and will operate in US dollars. The new card fee will be a hundred euro which will be deducted from your One Pay account upon approval. UnionPay is the only interbank network in China linking the ATMs of all banks throughout the mainland and is wildly accepted by the ATM and POS terminals in Macao and Hong Kong, as well as over 100 other countries around the globe. Keep an eye on the website for more information about the registration and card application procedure. Over 2000 OneCoin members and guests had the amazing chance to see Won Coin's founder and visionary, Dr Ruzsa Ignatova at the Won Coin International Convention and Charity Gala Dinner in Macau, on last Monday. The event, which took place at the Macau Fishermen's Wharf Convention and Exhibition Centre, was seen as one of the more important financial conferences in the region explaining how One Coin intends to become the most successful cryptocurrency in the world and what makes the One Coin product unique on the financial market. Dr Ruzsa made a number of important announcements about the company including, as we've just talked about the new 1.net UPA cards issued in association with Union Pay. She also outlined the possibility to transfer 1coins to other members, the amazing plus 1 split bonus and of course invited all the guests to the Coin Rush global event in London where they will receive extra exclusive news About OneCoin. All will run through shortly. OneCoin master distributor Sebastian Greenwood and top the onecoin family. At the end of the conference one lucky member received the grand prize in the lucky draw a brand new one hundred thousand euro car. In Macau we also announced a new and unique opportunity for all our members who want to get as many splits as possible. If you upgrade to an Infinity package from either Tycoon, Premium or Festival by the 5th of June 2016, you will get one extra split on top of what the upgrade initially gives you. For example if you have a Tycoon package and you upgrade to Infinity or Infinity Plus, for which you would initially get four splits, with the new Split promotion, you'll receive five, i.e. one more. The same is valid for all the other upgrades to Infinity from Tycoon packages upwards. If you have any questions regarding the new promotion, do not hesitate to contact our support team. Visit your back end now and upgrade your package to take advantage of this astonishing offer! Dr Ruza was also proud to announce that OneCoin has officially implemented the coin transfer option between members. Now you will be able to send and receive OneCoins to and from all members in your downline, as well as all your sponsors in your Upline. The procedure is similar to the cash transfers only operating with wants coins. You will be able to transfer coins once a day. Do note that you'll be unable to sell wantcoins on the exchange platform during the same day. Additionally, bear in mind that no cross-line transactions are allowed, only upline or downline. Each package comes with a set limit for transferrable coins daily. Starter with five, Trader, Protrader and ExecTrader and Exec trader with 10. Tycoon trader and Premium trader 25. Festival trader, a previous package in InfinityTrader, 40. The excitement is building and all eyes are turning to London. There's only one month left to go until the most anticipated event of the year the coin rush. Because the extreme interest our members and friends have shown, we decided to extend the ticket promotion and give you all the chance to get free tickets. If you buy ten tickets from the same category you can get one free! Do see the invitation video to event by Dr. Ruesa in your back office. Make sure you book your seats as soon as possible before they're sold out. In order to see our gratitude to our most dedicated supporters we're giving all members with Diamond rank and above two free tickets for the event. Keep in mind that if you reach Diamond rank within next month you'll also receive two free tickets. There are three ticket categories bronze at 100 euros, silver at 150 euros and gold at 200 euros the ticket classification is based on the proximity to the stage the higher the category the closer you'll be. Be sure to keep an eye on your back-end news section where we'll keep you up to date with all the information about the event. We're looking forward to seeing you all there. In respect of KYC procedures, please bear in mind that, if you decide to upload your national ID card, your national or international passport, if your address is shown in the document and if the stated credentials are written on different sides of your card or pages in your passport document, make sure that you upload all sides of your document. all KYC documents must be submitted in theGE language or written in Latin letters or they'll be rejected in those cases when you do not have officially issued documents in Latin letters we'll kindly ask you to provide us with an officially translated copy of your KYC documents in English made by an authorized translator the document should also be sealed and signed by a legal appropriate authority, for example a notary It is fine if the same authority both translates and legalises them. For our Chinese members, for your convenience, ONE.COIN offers translation services for your KYC documents, if you need us to translate your KYC files, the fee of 25€ will be withdrawn from your cash account. The increase in the fee is to support the verification process and we will optimize the procedure, allowing us to provide you with a timely and efficient service. A great way to drive your business is by collecting free package codes, codes that you can use yourself or utilize to motivate others in your business. Our free packages promotion continues with you able to get up to twenty seven and half thousand euro packages for free. If you bank in two codes codes you'll get one infinity code free if you bank ten premium codes you'll get one premium code free if you bank 10 tycoon codes you'll get one tycoon code free and if you bank six premium codes you'll get three pro two trades trader codes free and the coin Vegas promotion related to its its top package gives you an extra champion code if you bank in six champion codes. Do note that in order to get the free package, or packages you need to be clear in your communication with the accounting department of the company. First you need toulate the right number of codes related to the specific package or packages to get the free promotional code of codes 2 Report to the Accounting Department and all the codes you banked in one payment Remember to explain which codes correspond in which payments when you send the Banquoix. As we invest in and build our support of you, our members, as of this week you'll be able to send in your questions and how them answered in German Portuguese, Russian and Chinese. Send your message to each of the corresponding email addresses on the slide. We have always said that the One World Foundation and OneCoin are here for the long run. This is also the way we conduct our partnerships – we always look for ways to develop & expand them. Therefore we're extremely happy to continue working with the Orphans Future Charity Foundation in the Ukraine. After providing 10 computers for a computer lab in the Zavodsky state-run boarding school in the turnip hill region of the Ukraine last year, we continue with our support this year as well. Another boarding school will be added to the One World Foundation's list of supported schools. New computers will be brought and installed in the Turboyvlja boarding school for visually impaired children in Ukraine. The school is now home to roughly 150 children with eye problems and they will be able to play and study on the new computers. We've also covered the full rent for Ternopil Resource Centre for 2016 where boys and girls who left the orphanage institution in the Ukraine will have a safe place to spend the night, to take a shower, have something to eat or use the computer room. The other services are available there include internet access including scanner, photocopier and printing service for educational and employment purposes, library, laundry facilities, social service and employment purposes, library, laundry facility, social services and employment assistance as well as psychological help. Orphan graduates can also seek legal assistance and participate in workshops and seminars designed to help them make informed choices in respect of career options, personal finances, as well as health and family issues. May is full of exciting events. Thousands of people join the one coin family every week and our international team grows by the hour. The amazing one coin members work hard to make sure everyone is up to date with the most recent developments of the company. This is why there are so many trainings and workshops to help you boost your team's performance or just understand the concept most recent developments under water. This is why there are so many trainings and workshops to help you boost your team's performance or just understand the concept of WON COIN. There is SOMETHING for everyone... Check out the events and make sure you book your ticket for the one closest to you. On May 13th and 14th the team is in Indonesia May 14th, also in the Ukraine May 22nd, in Casablanca, Morocco and finally, from the 23rd to the 25th of May in Moscow, Russia For more information on the leadership training and presentation events please contact your upline, check our Facebook page or follow the news section on our official OneCoin website. That brings this week's State of the Nation to an end with lots of news from Macau and only a month to Coin Rush. You just have to be there. I'll be back next week to update you all on our progress hosted by myself, Paul Smith. Visit the OneCoin webinars YouTube channel or onecoin-sotn.com website with of course our Chinese language voiceover as well as English. Until next week, all the best from the whole OneCoin team.
